title: 10XBNB Alternatives: 6 Arbitrage Programs Compared (2026)
metaDescription: Six 10XBNB alternatives for Airbnb arbitrage and co-hosting, compared on format, coaching, deal review, landlord references and fit, with real student results.
h1: 10XBNB Alternatives: Six Airbnb Arbitrage Programs Compared
verdict: 10XBNB is a fair buy if you want arbitrage and co-hosting taught together in a self-paced library with a big group and live calls. It is a weaker fit if you want one coach who reads your lease and runs the numbers before you sign, or if you want to test the model cheaply first. Those two reasons drive most searches for alternatives, and they point to different programs.

Airbnb Ascension is our program and we flag it wherever it appears. It suits the one-coach, one-property, done-with-you buyer. Self-directed and want a refundable first step? Sean Rakidzich's courses beat both of us. Want to buy rather than lease? Skip every arbitrage program here. Our [three-way comparison](/blog/bnb-formula-vs-10xbnb-vs-airbnb-ascension) has the sourced detail.

competitorProfile.what: An Airbnb coaching brand from Shaun Ghavami and Ari Rahmanian that teaches three ways to earn without owning: rental arbitrage (lease, furnish, sublet nightly), bed flipping (rent by the room), and co-listing, its term for co-hosting someone else's listing for a share of revenue.
competitorProfile.format: Self-paced modules, an active private Facebook group and live group coaching calls. No price on the program, FAQ or reviews pages we checked; the FAQ routes you to a contact page. Verify the current offering before buying.

Buyers who need the price and refund terms in writing before a call
People who want to own the property; equity and depreciation are not in the model

Group coaching: your question competes with everyone else's, and nobody is accountable for your progress.

No published money-back guarantee on the pages we checked.

scenarios.why: Standard Ascension is one property in six months. Scale runs 12 months with no cap and no guaranteed count. 10XBNB covers scaling but reviews no individual deal.

whereLisFits: Airbnb Ascension is the pick when you want one person accountable to you and one property finished: a dedicated coach, a Market Matrix to choose the city, a Property Profitability Report before you sign, landlord scripts with roleplay and a coach who vouches for you, then done-for-you listing, furnishing, automation and pricing setup. The Airbnb Arbitrage Roadmap curriculum underneath is about 7 hours of video; the rest is people and process.

The results we cite are on our [reviews page](/reviews). [Tom](/blog/tom-zero-to-25k-two-weeks), after a corporate layoff, booked $25,000 in reservations in his first two weeks and reports $5,000 to $6,000 a month from his Chesapeake Bay unit. [Kiana](/blog/kiana-replaced-finance-job-airbnb) left a ten-year finance career, runs two Scottsdale units at about $3,200 a month, and quit her job three months in. Individual outcomes, not a promise. Our Trustpilot profile shows a 4.2 TrustScore from 66 reviews as of September 2026.
whereLisDoesNotFit: Ascension is the wrong first step if you want to test the idea cheaply: pricing is not published, there is no published money-back guarantee, and you bring your own capital for deposits and furniture. It is also wrong if you want more than one property in six months on the standard term, or if co-hosting is your starting point.

It is not for buyers. Our student [Jeff](/blog/jeff-8k-month-texas-airbnb) chose to buy his Galveston property after 28 years in banking and reports $7,000 to $8,000 a month after his mortgage. Different model, different tax picture. If ownership is your goal, read the [short-term rental loophole](/tax-strategies/short-term-rental-loophole) page before talking to us or to 10XBNB.
howToDecide: Check your target city's short-term rental rules. If stays under 30 days are banned where you can afford to lease, no program helps.
Decide lease or buy, then co-hosting or arbitrage. Buying points to an acquisition course; co-hosting to 10XBNB; arbitrage with a coach to Ascension; arbitrage alone to Rakidzich.
Count your reserve. If a program fee would eat the money you need for deposits and furniture, buy the cheap course and keep the cash.
Ask every seller the same four things in writing: the price, the refund policy, who coaches you, and whether they review your specific lease before you sign.
Run one deal through our [arbitrage ROI](/tools/airbnb-arbitrage-roi) and [break-even occupancy](/tools/str-break-even-occupancy) calculators. If it fails in a spreadsheet, no program fixes it.

faqs.q: Is 10XBNB legit?
faqs.a: It is an operating coaching company with public program pages, an active community and live group calls. Whether it is the right buy for you is a separate question: ask for the price and refund terms in writing, who coaches you and how often, and whether anyone reviews your specific lease. Judge every program, including ours, by those answers.

faqs.q: How much does 10XBNB cost?
faqs.a: 10XBNB does not publish a price; its FAQ sends you to a contact page. Airbnb Ascension does not publish one either; it is discussed on the strategy call. Sean Rakidzich's courses are the option here with a published price.

faqs.q: What is the difference between 10XBNB and Airbnb Ascension?
faqs.a: 10XBNB teaches arbitrage, bed flipping and co-listing through self-paced modules, a Facebook group and live group calls. Airbnb Ascension is a 6-month, one-property arbitrage program with a dedicated 1-on-1 coach, a Property Profitability Report on each deal, a landlord reference, and done-for-you setup after the lease. One is a broader library; the other is narrower and hands-on.

faqs.q: What is the best alternative to 10XBNB?
faqs.a: It depends on why you are leaving. A coach who reviews your lease and vouches for you: Airbnb Ascension. A published price and a 30-day refund: Sean Rakidzich. Buying instead of leasing: an acquisition course plus the short-term rental tax rules. Free: BiggerPockets and YouTube.

faqs.q: Do 10XBNB or Airbnb Ascension offer a money-back guarantee?
faqs.a: We found none on the 10XBNB pages we checked, and Airbnb Ascension does not publish one. Rakidzich publishes a 30-day money-back guarantee. Whatever you buy, get the refund policy in writing first.

faqs.q: How much money do I need to start Airbnb arbitrage?
faqs.a: Separate from any program cost, our guidance is roughly $10,000 to $25,000 of working capital for a first unit: deposit, first month's rent, furniture and a reserve for a slow first quarter. Run your target unit through our arbitrage ROI calculator before you commit.

If your real goal is the tax side, arbitrage may be the wrong vehicle. Our student [Jeff](/blog/jeff-8k-month-texas-airbnb) chose to buy his Galveston property after 28 years in banking and reports $7,000 to $8,000 a month after his mortgage. faqs.q: How much does BNB Formula cost?

faqs.q: What is the best alternative to BNB Formula?
faqs.a: A coach who reviews your lease and vouches for you with landlords: Airbnb Ascension. A published price and a 30-day refund: Sean Rakidzich. Co-hosting as a starting point: 10XBNB. Ownership and its tax benefits: an acquisition course plus the short-term rental loophole. Free: YouTube and BiggerPockets.

faqs.q: How is Airbnb arbitrage income taxed?
faqs.a: Arbitrage is a business you operate, not a property you own. Nightly revenue is business income; rent, furniture, supplies, cleaning, software and platform fees are business expenses. Because you do not own the building, there is nothing to depreciate and no cost segregation to run. This is education; confirm your facts with a tax professional.

faqs.q: Does the short-term rental loophole apply to Airbnb arbitrage?
faqs.a: Generally no. The loophole lets an owner who materially participates treat rental losses, usually created by depreciation, as non-passive so they can offset income such as W-2 wages. An arbitrage operator does not own the property, so there is no depreciation to create that loss. If that outcome is your goal, study ownership, not arbitrage.

faqs.q: Should I lease or buy my first short-term rental?
faqs.a: Lease if you want cash flow quickly with less capital and can stomach owing rent in a slow month. Buy if you have a down payment, want equity, and want the depreciation and STR tax rules that only owners get. Our students have done each: Tom and Kiana leased, Jeff bought.

title: Legacy Wealth Blueprint vs WealthAbility (2026)
metaDescription: Legacy Wealth Blueprint vs WealthAbility (Tom Wheelwright): who does the work, education vs a CPA network, real estate focus, W-2 vs owner fit, and what to ask.
h1: Legacy Wealth Blueprint vs WealthAbility (Tom Wheelwright)
verdict: These two solve different problems. WealthAbility is built around Tom Wheelwright's Tax-Free Wealth framework, and its main product is a match with a CPA firm in its network that plans and, in most engagements, files. Legacy Wealth Blueprint is a 12-month coached education program: you learn the strategies across five pillars, get a written plan and a 1-on-1 guide, and hand a CPA Implementation Brief to your own CPA, who decides what applies and files.

Pick WealthAbility if you want a vetted CPA to own the tax work and you already run a business or hold investments that give a planner real levers. Pick Legacy Wealth Blueprint if you want to understand your own money well enough to direct your CPA, if you are a W-2 earner whose problem is wider than taxes, or if you want to keep the CPA you have. Many people should do both, in that order.

verdict: This is not a like-for-like comparison. WCG CPAs is a Colorado-based CPA firm: you hire it for recurring work, tax planning, return preparation, and for small-business owners the S-corp payroll and bookkeeping that keep an entity compliant. Legacy Wealth Blueprint is a 12-month coached education program: you learn the strategies, get a written plan and a 1-on-1 guide, and hand a CPA Implementation Brief to whichever CPA files for you, which could be WCG.

Six-figure owners who want both understanding and execution should do both, in that order.

howToDecide: Answer one question first: do I need a return filed and an entity kept compliant this year? If yes, you need a firm regardless of anything else.
Answer a second: do I want to understand the strategy or delegate it? Delegate means firm. Understand means program. Both means program first.

faqs.q: Is WCG CPAs good for S-corp owners?
faqs.a: It is one of the better-known firms for that niche, with a public knowledge base on reasonable salary, accountable plans and multi-state issues that other preparers quote. Fit depends on the package, the states covered and how much planning contact you get outside filing season. Ask directly and verify the current offering.

faqs.q: Should I hire a CPA firm or take a tax strategy program?
faqs.a: Hire a firm if you need returns filed and an entity kept compliant and you are happy to delegate. Take a program if you want to understand and direct your plan, especially when your questions go beyond one entity. Do both if you are a six-figure owner who wants plan and execution, program first.

faqs.q: Can Legacy Wealth Blueprint replace my CPA?
faqs.a: No. It is education plus coaching with a written plan. It does not file returns, run payroll or give legal advice. If you have no CPA, the partner network includes a tax strategist at client pricing; confirm scope and fees first.

faqs.q: What should I ask a CPA firm before hiring them for S-corp work?
faqs.a: What is in the annual package and what is billed separately. Who does my work day to day. How reasonable salary is set and documented. Which states and entity types are covered. How often we talk outside filing season. Whether they will execute a strategy brief from outside the firm. What happens if I want to leave.

faqs.q: When do I need both a firm and a program?
faqs.a: When you have real business income that needs compliance and your questions go beyond the entity: debt, retirement accounts, a rental, a spouse's income, protection. The program builds the plan and the brief; the firm executes and files.
